name: ISO 4217 currency list (SIX Group), published 2026-01-01
mergedIntoNote: The binary format stores one source id per table, so a table built from several
upstreams is credited to its primary. `finance.currency` takes names and symbols from
CLDR and every numeric code from this registry, and is attributed to CLDR.
Declared rather than left to be rediscovered: `decoy-validate` reports a source that
claims no path, because that is normally a dependency paying for nothing. Here it is
the known attribution limitation instead, and a check whose one permanent warning is
explained in a document nobody opens is a check people stop reading.
note: SIX Group is the ISO 4217 maintenance agency -- this is the registry itself, not a
redistribution of it. Taken over the LGPL-licensed iso-codes package and over MIT
npm mirrors because both are copies of this, and a copy adds a licence to comply
Currency code assignments are facts: `AFN` is 971 because the registry says so, and
there is no authorship in the mapping to license. `public-facts` records that
reasoning rather than asserting a grant SIX has not made. The list is published free
of charge for exactly this use.
The URL is unversioned and changes in place, but the document declares its own
publication date in the `Pblshd` attribute, and the adapter asserts that date
matches `version` below. A republication therefore fails the integrity check first
and the date assertion second, rather than silently changing everyone's fixtures.
